name: reset
description: Clear all stored configuration for a provider: remove the api_key/base_url/last_verification dict, drop the cached catalogue, and unpin it as active if it was. Mirrors the legacy chrome.send 'resetProviderConfig' route used by the Models settings page's Reset button. Exposed on the panel WebUI bridge port only.

inputs.name: providerId
inputs.description: Provider id (anthropic / openai / google / ollama / chatgpt-pro / etc.)
